arms.R1: 200 production Adam then 50 iRprop+ steps on delivered score
arms.P2: 200 production Adam then 50 fresh Adam steps lr .01
arms.R2: 250 iRprop+ steps from initial theta, CPU full-solve sanity only

irprop.delta0: absolute last Adam effective step per row and DOF, archived before culling; fallback .01 for unavailable moments
irprop.idle: max abs update <1e-5 OR gradient norm <1e-8
irprop.best_seen: baseline and every post-update iterate including final update
irprop.backtrack: only sign-flipping DOFs, only if current row score < previous row score; clear gradient on flips

sanity.rows: 48 exact O1 rows, seed11, CPU float64 delivered objective
sanity.required: R1 median L-BFGS recovery >= paired P2 OR median energy change below paired P2; every row score nondecreasing
report: per-row convergence iteration (-1 means not converged at50)
per-iteration delta median and fractions at bounds
sanity.checkpoint: stop and report sanity numbers before cal

cal.device: paired 2060 controls; two-parent wall estimate first, if >8h use one paired Colab L4 jgB VM

panels.tail: only after cal passes; report, gate only obscene-rate guard

strata.N: unit paired C1 top1 energy <=200 kJ/mol
strata.O: unit paired C1 top1 energy >200 kJ/mol

primary: paired top1 energy difference: mean parent-clustered bootstrap 95% CI and median; all parents and per stratum
secondary: each arm against F.3 C0 2060 control (informational)
guards: N only: no parent worsens >25 kJ/mol on >=2/3 seeds; score up with energy up is inversion, otherwise method defect
cal obscene rate must not rise

bootstrap.unit: parent retaining paired seeds and fixed C1 stratum labels

failure_policy: record and continue; no imputation; incomplete gates cannot pass
checkpoint: G-3a′ report, commit, stop for audit
